why: This is a source-specific normative learner ideal and philosophical proposal, not a general explanatory theory of learning or teaching.
The Zhang and Li (2004) learner autonomy questionnaire is a named assessment instrument rather than a reusable instructional element.
name: Zhang and Li (2004) learner autonomy questionnaire
product_description: A 21-item self-report questionnaire developed by Zhang and Li to measure learner autonomy, using 11 frequency-scale items and 10 five-choice items.
